modules.name: ORIGIN VCO
modules.description: Voltage-controlled oscillator with triangle, sawtooth and pulse waveforms, pulse-width modulation and two pitch modulation inputs.

modules.name: FORM VCF
modules.description: Resonant four-pole low-pass filter with three audio inputs, three cutoff CV inputs and a separate output with switchable high-pass filtering.

modules.name: DYN VCA
modules.description: VCA with a three-input audio mixer, three gain CV inputs and selectable linear or exponential response.

modules.name: CONTOUR ADSR
modules.description: ADSR envelope generator with a manual gate button and positive and inverted outputs.

modules.name: CYCLE LFO
modules.description: LFO with four waveforms, three frequency ranges and adjustable fade-in.

modules.name: FUSE RING
modules.description: Bipolar ring modulator with two inputs, no input normalizations and one output.

modules.name: HISS NOISE
modules.description: White and pink noise generator with two identical outputs for each noise source.

modules.name: DRIFT S&H
modules.description: Sample and hold with internal white noise, internal clock, external sampling clock override and adjustable lag.

modules.name: BLEND MIXER
modules.description: Four-input mixer with duplicate sum and inverted outputs; inputs 3 and 4 are normalled to +10 V and -10 V, respectively.

modules.name: GLIDE PORTA
modules.description: Single-channel exponential portamento with a TIME slider and an LED indicating the time setting.

modules.name: PASS GATE
modules.description: Two independent signal gates with active-high and active-low CV inputs and OPEN indicators.

modules.name: BRANCH MULTIPLE
modules.description: Six independent multiples, each with one input and two identical outputs.

modules.name: SWIRL PHASER
modules.description: Six-stage phaser with an internal triangle LFO and an external modulation CV input.

modules.name: ECHO DELAY
modules.description: Short audio delay from 1 to 7 ms with a triangle LFO, feedback and effect bypass.

modules.name: SHIFT GATE DELAY
modules.description: Gate delay with adjustable threshold, delay and gate duration, and a 10 V output.

modules.name: STRIDE SEQUENCER
modules.description: Two-channel, eight-step sequencer with parallel operation or a series sequence of up to 16 steps on CV 1.

modules.name: TONE EQ
modules.description: Four-band parametric EQ with two identical outputs, bypass and SIGNAL/CLIP indicators.

modules.name: MAIN MIXER OUTPUT
modules.description: Four-channel stereo mixer with pan controls, faders, a reference oscillator and independent master and phones levels; no input normalizations.
